'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Chris Gogolen LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Gogolen]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' WTF?!?!?
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
